<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/smtp/test-connection"}
#docs
A refused connection is reported as `ok: false` with a 200 — the diagnosis is the result, not an API error.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `smtp_connection_test`. One of `smtp_connection_test`. |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True if the connection test passed. |
| `error` | `string` | Why the test failed, when it did. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Test performed |
| `400` | SMTP is not configured |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/smtp/test-connection" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "smtp_connection_test",
  "ok": false,
  "error": null
}
```
```json [400 Bad Request]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "SMTP is not configured"
  }
}
```
```json [409 Conflict]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "idempotency_error",
    "message": "Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload."
  }
}
```
:::
::
